blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in creative text generation, yet their ability to produce culturally grounded and stylistically constrained literary forms remains underexplored. Prior work has focused largely on modern language varieties and poetry, while classical prose traditions such as maqama (مقامة) remain largely unstudied. The maqama is a classical literary genre characterized by rhymed prose ( saj’ , سجع), dense rhetorical ornamentation, and episodic narrative structure, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating whether LLMs can move beyond surface fluency toward deeper literary competence. In this paper, we present the first controlled evaluation study of maqama generation with LLMs, comparing five models under zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based prompting, and evaluating outputs through both human annotation and an LLM-as-a-judge framework across dimensions such as rhetorical richness, saj’ density, structural coherence, and stylistic authenticity. Our results show that prompting strategy plays a strong role in stylistic quality: few-shot prompting most consistently improves saj’ density, while its effects on rhetoric and coherence vary by model, with the strongest models (GPT-4o and GPT-5.4-mini) benefiting most from rule-based prompting on these dimensions, though zero-shot prompting yields the highest aggregate scores across all five models. We further observe systematic differences between models in stylistic alignment with Arabic maqama conventions, and corroborate our findings with a second independent LLM judge, paired statistical significance testing, and non-LLM proxy measures of saj’.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在创造性文本生成中表现出了强大的表现,然而,它们制作基于文化的和有风格限制的文学形式的能力仍然没有得到充分发挥. 以前的工作主要集中于现代语言品种和诗歌,而古典传教传统如maqama(QQ)则基本没有研究. Maqama是一个古典文学流派,其特点是押韵流派(saj ' s, سجع ) 、 密集的辞藻装饰和零星的叙事结构,成为评价LLMS能否超越表面流畅度向更深层次的文学能力发展的一个挑战性试验床。 在本文中,我们用LLMS来介绍对maqama一代的首个可控评价研究,在零射线、少射线和基于规则的提示下比较五个模型,并通过人文注释和LLM-as-judge框架来评价产出,这些方面包括词藻丰富、Saj密度、结构一致性和结构真实性。 我们的结果显示,促动策略在质地上扮演着重要角色:很少的促动镜头能持续地提高Saj的密度,而它对言辞和一致性的影响则因模型而异,最强的模型(GPT-4o和GPT-5.4-mini)从这些层面的促动规则中得益最大,尽管零促动得分在所有五个模型中总分最高。 我们进一步观察到与阿拉伯马卡马公约在形式上一致的模式之间有系统性的差异,并用第二个独立的LLM法官来证实我们的结论,配对统计意义测试,以及Saj的非LLM代理测量。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in natural language generation across a wide range of tasks, including dialogue, summarization, and creative writing Brown et al. (2020) ; Touvron et al. (2023) . Despite these advances, their ability to generate text under strict stylistic, rhetorical, and historically grounded constraints remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在包括对话,归纳,以及创造性写作Brown等人(2020年)在内的一系列广泛任务中表现出了强大的自然语言生成能力;Touvron等人(2023年). 尽管取得了这些进展,但它们在严格的形式、修辞和历史制约下产生文本的能力仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: This challenge becomes especially evident in classical literary traditions, where success depends not only on grammatical fluency but also on adherence to genre-specific conventions. Among these traditions, the maqama (مقامة; plural maqamat , مقامات) occupies a central place in Arabic literary heritage.
blocks.zh: 这种挑战在古典文学传统中特别明显,因为文学的成功不仅取决于语法流利,而且取决于遵守与流派有关的公约。 在这些传统中,maqama(مقامة;复数maqamat,مقامات)在阿拉伯文学遗产中占据中心位置.

blocks.en: The maqama is a classical prose genre that emerged in the 10th century with Badi’ al-Zaman al-Hamadhani and later reached its most canonical form with al-Ḥariri . It is characterized by rhymed prose ( saj’ , سجع), dense rhetorical ornamentation, lexical ingenuity, and episodic storytelling Drory (2000) ; Hämeen-Anttila (2002) . Traditionally, maqamat revolve around a narrator recounting the exploits of a witty and eloquent protagonist, often involving deception, social critique, and displays of verbal mastery. The genre became one of the clearest demonstrations of linguistic virtuosity in Arabic literary history Drory (2000) ; Hämeen-Anttila (2002) . To illustrate these defining stylistic and rhetorical features, we include a representative excerpt from al-Hamadhani’s al-Maqama al-Ḥamdaniyya with English translation in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: Maqama是10世纪与Badi ' al-Zaman al-Hamadhani一起出现的古典流派,后来与al-Ḥariri一起达到其最古典的流派形式. 它的特点是押韵的散文(saj ' , سجع), 密集的修辞装饰, 名词精明, 传统上,maqamat围绕着一个旁白者讲述了一个机智和雄辩的主角的利用,常常涉及欺骗、社会批评和口头掌握。 该流派成为阿拉伯语文学史上最明显的语言虚拟表现之一。 为了说明这些界定性的语气和修辞特征,我们包括一个有代表性的摘录,取自al-Hamadhani的al-Maqama al-Ḥamdaniyya,英文译本见附录A。

blocks.en: Maqama generation presents an especially challenging testbed for modern LLMs for three reasons. First, it requires maintaining saj’, a structured rhymed prose form that demands phonological and lexical control beyond ordinary prose generation. Second, it relies heavily on rhetorical devices such as parallelism, antithesis, and semantic symmetry. Third, it requires preserving narrative coherence while sustaining a consistent classical register. These properties make maqama generation a useful benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can move beyond surface fluency toward deeper literary competence.
blocks.zh: Maqama一代由于三个原因,为现代有限责任公司提供了一个特别具有挑战性的试验床。 首先,它要求保持Saj ' ,一种结构化的押韵式的散文形式,要求超出普通散文生成的声学和词汇控制. 第二,它严重依赖并行主义,反神论,语义对称论等修辞手段. 第三,它要求保持叙事一致性,同时保持一贯的古典记录。 这些特性使Maqama一代成为评估LLMS能否超越表面流畅度而更深层次的文学能力的一个有用的基准.

blocks.en: While recent work has made substantial progress in controllable text generation and stylistic adaptation, including narrative planning and creative writing Fan et al. (2018) ; Rashkin et al. (2020) , little attention has been given to classical Arabic prose. Existing Arabic NLP research has focused primarily on Modern Standard Arabic, dialectal varieties, and poetry generation Antoun et al. (2020) ; Inoue et al. (2021) , leaving highly constrained prose genres largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 虽然近期的工作在可控文本生成和风格适应方面取得了实质性进展,包括叙事规划和创作Fan等人(2018年);Rashkin等人(2020年),但对古典阿拉伯语的传言很少重视. 现存的阿拉伯语NLP研究主要集中于现代标准阿拉伯语,方言品种,以及诗歌一代Antoun et al. (2020年); Inoue et al. (2021年),使得高度受限的亲子流派基本上没有得到探讨.

blocks.en: In this paper, we present the first controlled study of maqama generation using modern LLMs. We evaluate multiple models under three prompting regimes: zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based prompting, to assess their ability to reproduce the stylistic and structural properties of the genre. To do so, we introduce a structured evaluation framework combining human annotation and LLM-as-a-judge assessment across dimensions including grammar, saj’, rhetoric, coherence, creativity, relevance, and stylistic authenticity.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了使用现代LLMs对maqama生成进行的第一次控制研究. 我们评价三种激励机制下的多种模式:零射、少射和有章可循的激励,以评估其复制流派的形态和结构特性的能力。 为此,我们引入了一个结构化的评价框架,将人的注释和LLM-as-a-judge的各方面评估结合起来,包括语法、Saj ' 、修辞、一致性、创造力、相关性和结构真实性。

blocks.en: Our study addresses four research questions:
blocks.zh: 我们的研究涉及四个研究问题:

blocks.en: • RQ1: Can modern LLMs generate coherent maqama-style prose that preserves key classical literary properties? • RQ2: How do different prompting strategies affect stylistic fidelity and rhetorical quality? • RQ3: Which literary dimensions are most sensitive to prompt engineering, and which remain primarily model-dependent? • RQ4: To what extent do absolute rubric-based and pairwise comparative evaluations agree when assessing highly stylized literary generation?
blocks.zh: • RQ1:现代的LLMS能否产生一致的maqama风格的散文,保留关键的古典文学属性? • RQ2:不同的促动策略如何影响质地忠诚和修辞的质量? • RQ3:哪些文学维度对即时工程最敏感,哪些仍然主要依赖模型? • 支助 RQ4:在评估高度阶梯化的文学生成时,基于绝对值和对称的比较评价在多大程度上一致?

blocks.en: RQ1: Can modern LLMs generate coherent maqama-style prose that preserves key classical literary properties?
blocks.zh: RQ1:现代的LLMS能否产生一致的maqama风格的传言,保留关键的古典文学属性?

blocks.en: RQ2: How do different prompting strategies affect stylistic fidelity and rhetorical quality?
blocks.zh: RQ2:不同的激励策略如何影响质地忠诚和修辞的质量?

blocks.en: RQ3: Which literary dimensions are most sensitive to prompt engineering, and which remain primarily model-dependent?
blocks.zh: RQ3:哪些文学维度对即时工程最敏感,哪些仍然主要依赖模型?

blocks.en: RQ4: To what extent do absolute rubric-based and pairwise comparative evaluations agree when assessing highly stylized literary generation?
blocks.zh: RQ4:在评估高度阶梯化的文学生成时,基于绝对值和对称的比较评价在多大程度上一致?

blocks.en: By answering these questions, this work contributes the first systematic evaluation study of maqama generation, provides empirical evidence on prompt sensitivity in constrained literary generation, and offers broader insights into the limits of stylistic controllability in LLMs. We release the full set of topics, prompts, and generated outputs to support future benchmarking and comparative studies on this task.
blocks.zh: 这部作品通过回答这些问题,为对maqama一代的首次系统评价研究做出了贡献,提供了在受限的文学一代中迅速敏感的经验性证据,并对LLMs中结构控制力的局限性提供了更广泛的见解. 我们公布一整套专题、提示和产出,以支持今后关于这项任务的基准和比较研究。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Large language models have enabled significant progress in text generation, particularly through prompting-based control mechanisms such as few-shot learning and instruction tuning Brown et al. (2020) ; Wei et al. (2022) . These approaches allow models to adapt to new tasks without parameter updates and have been widely studied in both analytical and creative settings.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型使文本生成工作取得了显著进展,特别是通过以催化为基础的控制机制,例如:少拍学习和教学调整Brown等人(2020年);Wei等人(2022年)。 这些方法使模型能够在没有参数更新的情况下适应新的任务,并在分析和创造性的环境下得到了广泛的研究.

blocks.en: Prior work has explored controllable storytelling and narrative generation using neural models, focusing on coherence, plot structure, and long-form generation Fan et al. (2018) ; Rashkin et al. (2020) . However, such studies primarily target modern genres and do not address historically grounded literary traditions.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作探索了使用神经模型进行可控的故事叙述和叙事生成,重点是一致性,图案结构,以及长式生成范等人(2018年);Rashkin等人(2020年). 然而,这类研究主要针对现代流派,并不涉及历史遗留下来的文学传统.

blocks.en:
Arabic NLP has evolved from early feature-based and transformer-based models such as AraBERT and CAMeLBERT Antoun et al. (2020) ; Inoue et al. (2021) to modern large language models capable of open-ended generation.
More recent Arabic-capable or Arabic-focused LLMs include models such as ALLaM Bari et al. (2024) , Jais Sengupta et al. (2023) , and Falcon variants Boussaha et al. (2025) , which incorporate Arabic data either through multilingual pretraining or targeted dataset curation.
blocks.zh:
阿拉伯语NLP从早期基于特性的和基于变压器的模型,如AraBERT和CAMELBERT Antoun等人(2020年);Inoue等人(2021年),演变为能够无限制生成的现代大语言模型.
较近期的阿拉伯语能力或以阿拉伯语为重点的LLMs包括ALLAM Bari等人(2024年)、Jais Sengupta等人(2023年)和Falcon变体Boussaha等人(2025年)等模型,它们通过多语种预训或定向数据集解析,纳入了阿拉伯语数据。

blocks.en: In parallel, general-purpose instruction-tuned LLMs such as GPT-4-class models and LLaMA-family models have demonstrated strong multilingual capabilities, including in Arabic generation, despite not being explicitly optimized for classical language varieties. These models often exhibit strong fluency in Modern Standard Arabic but varying ability to capture stylistically constrained or historically grounded forms.
blocks.zh: 同时,GPT-4级模型和LLaMA-家庭模型等通用教学调制LLMs也显示出强大的多语言能力,包括阿拉伯语一代,尽管没有为古典语言品种明确优化. 这些模型在现代标准阿拉伯语中往往表现出很流利的流利,但捕捉在风格上受限制或历史上受限制的形式的能力却各不相同。

blocks.en: While some recent work explores generative capabilities in Arabic, including poetry and stylistic generation Sadallah et al. (2026) ; Al Ghallabi et al. (2025) , these efforts have primarily focused on controllable poetry generation or poetic understanding benchmarks, with classical Arabic prose and rhetorical genres remaining relatively underexplored.
blocks.zh: 虽然最近的一些作品探索了阿拉伯语的基因能力,包括诗歌和造型一代Sadallah等人(2026年);Al Ghallabi等人(2025年),但这些努力主要侧重于可控的诗歌创作或诗意理解基准,古典阿拉伯语的散文和修辞流派仍然相对未得到充分探讨.

blocks.en: Evaluating open-ended generation remains challenging. LLM-as-a-judge frameworks have been proposed as scalable alternatives to human evaluation Zheng et al. (2023) , and have also been adopted in recent Arabic NLP work Sadallah et al. (2026) . While effective in many settings, relying solely on LLM-based evaluation may introduce biases toward surface-level fluency and make results sensitive to prompt framing.
blocks.zh: 评价不限名额的一代仍然具有挑战性。 已提出LLM-as-a-judge框架,作为人类评价的可扩展替代方案Zheng等人(2023年),最近阿拉伯NLP著作Sadallah等人(2026年)也采用了该框架。 在许多情况下虽然有效,但仅仅依靠基于LLM的评价可能会对地表水平流畅性产生偏见,并使结果对迅速制定具有敏感性。

blocks.en: Recent work has shown that multilingual competence does not necessarily imply cultural competence, particularly in historically situated or tradition-bound forms of language use Bagheri Nezhad (2026) . These limitations become especially pronounced in literary genres such as the maqama, where meaning depends not only on semantic adequacy but on mastery of inherited rhetorical conventions, stylistic rhythm, and cultural-literary context.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,多语种能力不一定意味着文化能力,特别是在历史位置或传统语言中使用的巴盖里内兹哈德语(2026年)。 这些限制在文学流派如maqama中变得特别明显,其意义不仅取决于语义上的充足性,还取决于对继承的修辞公约,风格节奏,以及文化-文学背景的掌握.

blocks.en: Despite progress in controllable generation and narrative modeling, no prior work has systematically studied maqama generation or evaluated LLMs on classical Arabic rhetorical prose.
blocks.zh: 尽管在可控生成和叙事模式方面有所进展,但以前的工作没有系统地研究maqama生成或评价关于古典阿拉伯语修辞的LLMs。

blocks.en: 3 Data and Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 数据和实验设置

blocks.en: In the absence of a standardized dataset for classical Arabic maqamat, we construct a controlled synthetic generation suite using five large language models: GPT-4o, GPT-5.4-mini, ALLaM-7B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, and LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct. Model selection follows prior work on Arabic constrained and literary domains, particularly recent studies on Arabic poetry such as Sadallah et al. (2026) , which employ a similar mixture of proprietary and open-weight multilingual and Arabic-capable models; our objective is to evaluate representative state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight systems under a common protocol rather than to isolate the effects of model scale or training. All models are queried under identical decoding settings, with temperature set to 0.7, a value commonly used for creative text generation and consistent with prior literary generation work Peeperkorn et al. (2024) ; Lewis et al. (2021) , and a maximum generation length of 2400 tokens.
blocks.zh: 由于缺乏古典阿拉伯语maqamat的标准化数据集,我们用五种大语言模型构建了控制合成生成套件:GPT-4o,GPT-5.4-mini,AllaM-7B-Instruct,Qune3-8B,以及LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct. 模式选择沿用了以前关于阿拉伯语受限制和文学领域的工作,特别是最近关于阿拉伯语诗歌的研究,如Sadallah等人(2026年),这些诗歌采用了类似的专有和开放量的多语种和阿拉伯语能力模式;我们的目标是根据共同协议评价有代表性的最先进的专有和开放量的系统,而不是孤立模式规模或培训的效果。 所有模型都在相同的解码设置下被询问,温度设定为0.7,这是创作文本生成常用的数值,并与之前的文学创作作品Peperkorn 等人(2024年);刘易斯等人(2021年),最大生成长度为2400令牌.

blocks.en: We define a set of 14 thematic prompts inspired by classical maqama scenarios, including travel narratives, deception, rhetorical contests, social satire, and culturally hybrid situations, themes central to the maqama tradition and discussed in Drory (2000) ; Hämeen-Anttila (2002) . For each configuration ( model × topic × prompting condition \text{model}\times\text{topic}\times\text{prompting condition} ), we generate N = 5 N=5 independent samples, resulting in a fully factorial synthetic dataset of maqama-style outputs stored in JSONL format with full metadata for reproducibility. We release the full topic list and generated outputs as supplementary material to support reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 我们从古典的maqama情景出发,定义了一组14个专题提示,包括旅行叙事、欺骗、修辞比赛、社会讽刺和文化杂交的情况、maqama传统的核心主题,并在Drory(2000年);Hämeen-Anttila(2002年)。 对于每个配置(模型×主题×提示条件\text{model{times\text{topic_times\text{protinting constitle}),我们生成N=5N=5独立样本,形成一个完全因子化的maqama式输出的合成数据集,以JSONL格式存储,完整元数据可以复制. 我们公布了全部专题清单,并产生了产出,作为支持可复制性的补充材料。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Prompting Strategies
blocks.zh: 4.1 迅速战略

blocks.en: To study the effect of in-context conditioning on stylistic generation, we apply three prompting strategies across all models and topics:
blocks.zh: 为了研究文本内条件对结构生成的影响,我们在所有模型和专题中采用了三个激励战略:

blocks.en: • Zero-Shot: Minimal instruction prompting using only the target topic. • Few-Shot: In-context learning using exemplar classical maqama excerpts to induce stylistic imitation. • Rule-Based: Structured instructions enforcing classical rhetorical constraints, including saj’, rhetorical devices, and narrative progression.
blocks.zh: • 零热:只使用目标主题的最小指示。 ^ 少数-Shot:内文学习,使用exemplar古典maqama节选来诱导语义模仿. · 以规则为基础:结构化指示,执行古典辞典约束,包括saj ' 、修辞手段和叙事进展。

blocks.en: Zero-Shot: Minimal instruction prompting using only the target topic.
blocks.zh: Zero-Shot:只使用目标主题提示的最小指令.

blocks.en: Few-Shot: In-context learning using exemplar classical maqama excerpts to induce stylistic imitation.
blocks.zh: 少圣:内文学习,使用实例古典maqama节选来诱导文体模仿.

blocks.en: Rule-Based: Structured instructions enforcing classical rhetorical constraints, including saj’, rhetorical devices, and narrative progression.
blocks.zh: 基于规则:结构化指令执行古典辞典约束,包括Saj ' 、修辞手段和叙事进展。

blocks.en: All full prompt templates are provided in the Appendix for reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 附录提供了所有完整的即时模板,以供复制。

blocks.en: 4.2 Automatic Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 自动评价

blocks.en: We evaluate model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge framework based on Claude Sonnet (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929). Evaluation is implemented via structured tool use, enforcing constrained outputs rather than free-form judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们利用基于Claude Sonnet(Claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929)的LLM-as-a-judge框架评价模型产出。 评价是通过使用结构化工具进行的,执行受限制的产出,而不是自由形式的判断。

blocks.en: We conduct two complementary evaluation protocols. First, an absolute evaluation setting where each generated maqama is independently scored on a 1–5 Likert scale across multiple dimensions: grammar, saj’, rhetorical richness, coherence, creativity, relevance, authenticity, and overall quality. Second, a pairwise evaluation setting where two outputs are compared directly, and the evaluator selects a winner along with per-dimension comparative scores.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了两项补充评估协议。 首先,每个生成的maqama的绝对评价设定在1到5个类似尺度上独立得分,涉及多个层面:语法、Saj、修辞丰富、一致性、创造力、相关性、真实性和整体质量。 第二,直接比较两个产出的双向评价设置,评价人员将选择一个优胜者以及每个优胜者的比较分数。

blocks.en: To improve robustness, evaluations are performed with temperature set to 0, and included randomized pairing order to mitigate positional bias. In the pairwise setting, the identity of the candidates is randomly swapped and later remapped to their original model identities.
blocks.zh: 为了提高稳健性,评价工作的温度定为0,并包括随机配对顺序,以减少位置偏差。 在对称设置中,候选人的身份被随机互换,后来重新映射到原来的模型身份.

blocks.en: The full evaluation prompts used for both absolute and pairwise settings are provided in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 附录提供了绝对和对等设置所用的全部评价提示。

blocks.en: 4.3 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 人类评价

blocks.en: To complement automatic evaluation, we conduct a human evaluation study with two annotators who are native Arabic speakers with a strong background in classical Arabic language and literary studies. We construct a balanced set of 60 maqamat (30 pairwise comparisons) sampled to cover all ten model pairs across all three prompting strategies.
blocks.zh: 作为自动评估的补充,我们与两位讲古典阿拉伯语和文学研究背景丰富的母语阿拉伯语的注解者进行了一项人文评估研究。 我们构建了一套60马卡马特(30对比)的平衡的样本,以涵盖所有三个促动战略的所有10对模型。

blocks.en: The evaluation includes two complementary comparison settings. First, annotators perform cross-model comparisons, where outputs from different models are directly compared under identical prompts. Second, to isolate the effect of prompting strategy, annotators additionally compare outputs generated by the same model across different prompting conditions (zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based).
blocks.zh: 评价包括两个互补的比较设置。 首先,注释员进行跨模型比较,不同模型的输出在相同的提示下直接比较. 第二,为了隔离促进战略的效果,注释者在不同的促进条件(零射、少射和按规则)中进一步比较同一模型产生的产出。

blocks.en: Annotators are asked to select a preferred output in each pair and provide a brief justification focusing on overall literary quality. To mitigate position and cognitive bias, text pairs are presented in a fully randomized, double-blind layout with all model names and prompt metadata stripped. Annotators perform a forced-choice pairwise preference selection based on structural adherence to classical maqama style (focusing heavily on saj’ precision, rhetorical flair, and narrative cohesion). Inter-annotator agreement is quantified using Cohen’s Kappa ( κ \kappa ).
blocks.zh: 要求注释者在每对作品中选择首选的输出,并提供以整体文学质量为重点的简短理由. 为了减轻位置和认知偏差,文本对子以完全随机的双盲布局呈现,所有模型名称和即时元数据剥离. 评论家们在结构上坚持古典的maqama风格(主要侧重于Saj的精度、修辞的魅力和叙事的凝聚力)的基础上, 校对:Soup

blocks.en: Table 1: Average Claude-Sonnet-4.5-as-judge evaluation scores (1–5) for GPT-4o and GPT-5.4-mini across prompting conditions and quality dimensions.
blocks.zh: 表1:GPT-4o和GPT-5.4-mini的Claude-Sonnet-4.5-sjudge平均评分(1-5),涉及促进条件和质量层面。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate model outputs using both absolute rubric-based scoring and pairwise comparative judgment, enabling both independent quality assessment and relative ranking. Full supplementary analyses are reported in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们利用绝对数字的评分和对等的比较判断来评价模型产出,从而能够进行独立的质量评估和相对排名。 完整的补充分析载于附录D。

blocks.en: 5.1 Absolute Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 绝对评价

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the mean absolute scores across all evaluation dimensions.
blocks.zh: 表2报告所有评价方面的平均绝对分数。

blocks.en: Table 2: Mean absolute evaluation score per dimension for each model, averaged across all three prompting conditions.
blocks.zh: 表2:每个模型每个维度的平均绝对评价分数,在所有三个促动条件中均值。

blocks.en: GPT-5.4-mini substantially outperforms all baselines, particularly in maqama-specific dimensions such as saj’, rhetoric, and authenticity, where weaker models collapse despite retaining moderate grammaticality. This suggests that literary imitation requires capabilities beyond surface-level fluency.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.4-mini的绩效大大超过所有基线,特别是在马卡马特有的层面,如saj ' 、修辞和真实性,尽管保留了中度语法,但较弱的模型崩溃。 这表明文学模仿需要超越表面水平流畅的能力.

blocks.en: Notably, GPT-4o achieves relatively strong grammatical and coherence scores but remains significantly weaker in authenticity, indicating partial stylistic imitation without full genre realization. Despite being Arabic-specialized, ALLaM underperforms in most literary dimensions, suggesting that general Arabic fluency alone does not translate to classical maqama competence.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,GPT-4o取得了相对强大的语法和一致性分数,但在真实性上仍然明显弱化,表明部分的风格仿真没有完全流派的实现. 尽管是阿拉伯语专业的,但ALLAM在大多数文学方面表现不佳,说明一般的阿拉伯语流利本身并不能转化为古典的maqama能力.

blocks.en: Beyond mean scores, GPT-5.4-mini also achieves the lowest variance among the two strong-performing models (Overall std. 0.38 vs. 0.53 for GPT-4o), indicating not only higher but more consistent quality across topics and samples; open-weight models exhibit both lower performance and reduced stability. A full stability breakdown for all five models is provided in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: 除了平均分数之外,GPT-5.4-mini还实现了两个强性能模型中的最低差异(总体标准0.38对GPT-4o的0.53),不仅表明各个主题和样本的质量更高,而且更加一致;开放量级模型表现出的性能较低,稳定性降低. 附录D.1提供了所有5种模型的完全稳定性崩溃情况。

blocks.en: 5.2 Prompting Effects
blocks.zh: 5.2 迅速效应

blocks.en: To assess prompt sensitivity, we compare model performance across three prompting conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了评估迅速的敏感性,我们比较三个迅速条件的模型性能。

blocks.en: Table 3: Mean overall score by prompting condition.
blocks.zh: 表3:按提示条件分列的总平均分。

blocks.en: Few-shot prompting yields the largest gains for GPT-4o (+0.54), while GPT-5.4-mini remains comparatively stable across all conditions, suggesting lower dependence on prompt scaffolding. This pattern indicates that stronger models internalize stylistic constraints more effectively, whereas weaker models benefit more from explicit examples.
blocks.zh: 少发点火能产生GPT-4o(+0.54)的最大收益,而GPT-5.4-mini在所有条件下都保持相对稳定,这表明对即时脚手架的依赖程度较低。 这种模式表明,较强的模型更有效地将结构约束内化,而较弱的模型则更多地受益于明确的例子。

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the full per-dimension breakdown for these two strongest models across prompting conditions. Both GPT-4o and GPT-5.4-mini achieve their best rhetoric and coherence scores under rule-based or few-shot prompting, whereas the aggregate result across all five models (Table 11 ) favors zero-shot prompting on these same dimensions, since the weaker open-weight models are destabilized by structured or few-shot prompting. Table 10 (Appendix D.5 ) reports this fine-grained breakdown for all five models and complements, rather than subsumes, the aggregate Overall score reported in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 表1报告这两个最强模型在各种快速条件下的全分解情况。 GPT-4o和GPT-5.4-mini在基于规则的或几发的提示下都取得了最佳的言辞和一致性分数,而所有5种模式的总结果(表11)都倾向于以零发的提示这些相同的维度,因为较弱的开放量模型由于结构化或几发的提示而不稳定。 表10(附录D.5)报告所有5种模式的细微细分,补充而不是包含表3中报告的总分。

blocks.en: A full prompt sensitivity breakdown appears in Appendix D.2 .
blocks.zh: 全面迅速的敏感性分解情况见附录D.2。

blocks.en: 5.3 Pairwise Comparison
blocks.zh: 5.3 对等比较

blocks.en: We complement absolute scoring with pairwise comparative evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们用双向比较评价来补充绝对评分。

blocks.en: Table 4: Pairwise win-rate matrix.
blocks.zh: 表4:对等双率矩阵。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 4 , pairwise judgments produce a clean hierarchy. GPT-5.4-mini achieves a perfect win rate against all competing systems, while GPT-4o consistently defeats all non-GPT baselines. Among open models, ALLaM substantially outperforms both Qwen and LLaMA, supporting the hypothesis that Arabic specialization provides some advantage, even when insufficient for strong maqama generation. One pair is not statistically distinguishable from chance: LLaMA’s win rate over Qwen is 52.4% (bootstrap 95% CI [0.381, 0.667]), so the relative order of the two lowest-ranked models should be interpreted with caution despite their separation in Elo.
blocks.zh: 如表4所示,对等判断产生一个干净的等级。 GPT-5.4-mini对所有竞技系统实现完美的胜率,而GPT-4o则始终击败所有非GPT基线. 在开放模型中,ALLaM的性能大大超过Quen和LLaMA,支持阿拉伯语专业化提供一定优势的假设,即使不足以培养强大的maqama一代. 在统计学上,一对模型与机会是无法区分的:LLaMA胜于Quen的胜率是52.4%(bootstrap 95% CI [0.381,0.667]),因此,尽管在埃洛分离,两种排名最低的模型的相对顺序应该谨慎解释.

blocks.en: 5.4 Global Ranking
blocks.zh: 5.4 全球排名

blocks.en: To derive a global comparative ranking, we compute Elo scores over pairwise outcomes.
blocks.zh: 为了获得全球的比较排名,我们计算Elo的得分比对结果。

blocks.en: Table 5: Elo ranking derived from pairwise comparisons.
blocks.zh: 表5:Elo排名通过对等比较得出.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , the Elo results reveal four distinct performance tiers, with large separations between adjacent systems. The strongest gap appears between GPT-5.4-mini and GPT-4o (+341 Elo), highlighting a substantial qualitative leap in literary competence.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,埃洛结果显示四个不同的性能等级,相邻系统之间有较大的分离. 最大的差距出现在GPT-5.4-mini和GPT-4o(+341 Elo)之间,凸显了文学能力在质量上的巨大飞跃.

blocks.en: To assess the robustness of this ranking, we conducted bootstrap confidence interval estimation and paired Wilcoxon signed-rank significance testing on all 1,050 absolute judgments, matched by condition, topic, and sample. Every pairwise difference in mean Overall score between the five models is significant at p < 0.001 p<0.001 , surviving Holm-Bonferroni correction across all ten pairwise comparisons, indicating that the reported ranking is statistically robust with the single exception noted above (LLaMA vs. Qwen). We further re-evaluated the full corpus (1,050 absolute judgments and 420 pairwise comparisons) using Gemini 3.5 Flash as an independent second LLM judge, following the practice of using an external judge model to avoid bias toward any evaluated model family Sadallah et al. (2026) . Agreement between the two judges is strong: Spearman ρ = 0.878 \rho=0.878 on absolute Overall scores (per-dimension ρ = 0.746 \rho=0.746 – 0.945 0.945 ), 93.3% raw agreement and Cohen’s κ = 0.907 \kappa=0.907 on pairwise winners, and ρ = 0.90 \rho=0.90 agreement on the resulting five-model ranking, differing by only a single adjacent swap between the third- and fourth-ranked models (ALLaM and Qwen). Combined, these results indicate that the reported model ranking is stable across statistical testing and judge model, not solely dependent on Claude Sonnet 4.5.
blocks.zh: 为了评估这一排名的稳健性,我们进行了靴子置信间隔估计,并对所有1 050个绝对判断进行了Wilcoxon签名级意义测试,与条件、主题和样本相匹配。 在p < 0.001 p < 0.001 > 中,五个模型之间平均总分的每对比值差异都是显著的,在十对比中幸存的Holm-Bonferroni校正,这表明所报告的排名在统计学上是稳健的,只有上述一个例外(LLaMA vs. Quen)。 我们进一步重新评价了将双子座3.5 Flash作为独立的第二位LLM法官的全案(1,050项绝对判决和420项对等比较),遵循了使用外部法官模式以避免偏向任何被评价的Sadallah等人模式的做法(2026年)。 两位评委之间有强烈的共识:Spearman $ = 0.878\rho = 0.878 在绝对总分(每分数 ^ = 0.746\rho = 0.746 – 0.945 ),93.3%的原始协议和 Cohen 的 ^ 0.907\kappa = 0.907 在对双向胜者进行排名时,对结果的五模式排名有一致的 ^ = 0.90\rho = 0.90 ,只有单次相邻的三等和四等胜者(ALAM 和 Quen)互换而不同. 综合起来,这些结果表明,所报告的模型排名在统计测试和判断模型之间是稳定的,而不仅仅依赖于Claude Sonnet 4.5.

blocks.en: Agreement between absolute and pairwise rankings is analyzed in Appendix D.3 .
blocks.zh: 附录D.3分析了绝对排名和对等排名之间的一致。

blocks.en: 5.5 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.5 人类评价

blocks.en: Human evaluation shows strong consistency between annotators, with a raw agreement of 0.9667 and a Cohen’s kappa of 0.9231, indicating near-perfect inter-annotator reliability. This high agreement suggests that preferences among maqama outputs are highly stable and that stylistic quality is clearly discernible to expert Arabic readers.
blocks.zh: 人类评价显示,注释者之间有很强的一致性,原始协议为0.9667,科恩的kappa为0.9231,表明几乎完美无缺的注释者之间的可靠性。 这种高水平的协议表明,马卡马产出之间的偏好非常稳定,阿拉伯专家读者清楚地看到结构质量。

blocks.en: Across evaluations, both annotators consistently preferred few-shot and rule-based prompting outputs over zero-shot generations, highlighting the importance of explicit stylistic conditioning for achieving classical maqama fidelity. Annotators emphasized that improvements were primarily driven by better control of saj’ structure, rhetorical density, and narrative cohesion.
blocks.zh: 在整个评价中,无论是注解者还是注解者,都始终倾向于少拍少拍和有章可循的促动产出,而不是零拍几代,这突出表明了明确的形式条件对实现古典maqama忠贞的重要性。 注释者强调,改善主要取决于更好地控制Saj的结构、言语密度和叙事凝聚力。

blocks.en: A notable qualitative finding was the presence of hallucinated or structurally invalid content in several open-source model outputs, including repetitive passages and occasional fabricated religious quotations attributed to the Qur’an and Hadith.
blocks.zh: 一个显著的定性发现是在若干开放源代码模型产出中出现了幻觉或结构上无效的内容,包括重复的段落和偶尔编造的可归结为《古兰经》和《哈迪思》的宗教引文。

blocks.en: Overall, closed-source models significantly outperformed open-source alternatives in perceived maqama quality. GPT-5.4-mini achieved a consistent win across all pairwise comparisons, followed by GPT-4o, which also showed strong and stable performance against all remaining models. This ranking closely aligns with the LLM-as-a-judge results using Claude Sonnet 4.5, indicating strong agreement between automated and human evaluation signals.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,封闭源代码模型在所感知的maqama质量方面明显超过开放源代码替代品。 GPT-5.4-mini在所有对偶比较中取得了一致的胜负,其次是GPT-4o,它也显示出了相对于所有剩余模型的强而稳定的性能. 这一排名与使用Claude Sonnet 4.5的LLM-as-a-judge结果密切吻合,表明自动化和人类评价信号之间的强烈一致。

blocks.en: 5.6 Non-LLM Validation of Saj’
blocks.zh: 5.6 非LLM 语言学 Saj的鉴定 ' ' 说

blocks.en: To support the literary evaluation with evidence independent of LLM judgment, we implemented two deterministic, non-LLM proxy measures for saj’: rhyme-ending consistency (the proportion of adjacent clause pairs sharing the same final letter) and cadence regularity (based on the coefficient of variation in clause length), computed directly on all 1,050 generated maqamat. Rhyme-ending consistency correlates significantly with the LLM judge’s saj’ scores (Spearman’s ρ = 0.328 \rho=0.328 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), indicating that the judge’s assessments are at least partly grounded in measurable stylistic properties rather than arbitrary. These proxies are intentionally lightweight and are not intended to replace literary evaluation; a fuller computational assessment of saj’ would require substantially richer linguistic modeling, which we leave to future work.
blocks.zh: 为了用独立于LLM判断之外的证据支持文学评价,我们针对Saj实施了两种确定性、非LLM的代用措施:韵律一致(相邻条款对子的比例共享同一个最终字母)和节奏规律(根据条款长度变化系数),直接计算在所有1 050个生成的maqamat上。 韵律上的一致与LLM法官的评分(Spearman ρ = 0.328\rho = 0.328,p < 0.001 p < 0.001)有重大关系,表明法官的评分至少部分基于可测量的语气特性,而不是任意性。 这些代词有意轻而易举,并不是为了取代文学评价;对saj ' 的更充分的计算评估需要更丰富的语言模型,我们留给未来工作。

blocks.en: 5.7 Diacritization
blocks.zh: 5.7 糖尿病

blocks.en: Motivated by the observation that classical maqamat are conventionally diacritized, we additionally analyzed the density of diacritic marks in the generated corpus. Few-shot prompting consistently produced substantially more diacritized output than zero-shot or rule-based prompting across all evaluated models (for example, Qwen increased from 30.6 to 77.3 diacritic marks per 100 Arabic letters), suggesting that models largely acquire this behavior by imitating the diacritized in-context exemplars rather than through an intrinsic tendency to vocalize the text. Evaluating the correctness of generated diacritics, as opposed to their mere presence, requires gold-standard diacritized references and dedicated evaluation metrics; we leave diacritization-aware prompting and rigorous evaluation of vocalization quality, including its interaction with literary devices such as jinās , to future work.
blocks.zh: 由于古典maqamat被传统地分化的观察,我们进一步分析了生成物中分化标记的密度。 很少有镜头连续地产生比所有被评价的模型的零镜头或基于规则的提示要多得多的二射输出(例如,Quen从每100个阿拉伯字母的30.6个二射标记增加到77.3个二射标记),这表明模型在很大程度上通过模仿二射文字中的二射实例而不是通过内在的发声倾向来获得这种行为. 评估生成的二极论的正确性, 而不是它们的存在, 需要黄金标准二极化的参考和专用的评价度量; 我们让二极化 - 意识 - 激励和严格评价声学质量,

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our findings reveal that maqama generation remains a highly demanding literary task for current language models. While strong general language ability is necessary, it is not sufficient for successful maqama generation, which requires mastery of genre-specific constraints such as saj’, rhetorical ornamentation, and stylistic authenticity.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果表明,马卡马一代仍然是目前语言模式要求很高的文学任务。 虽然强大的一般语言能力是必要的,但不足以让Maqama一代成功,这需要掌握不同流派特有的制约因素,如Saj ' 、修辞装饰和结构真实性。

blocks.en: GPT-5.4-mini demonstrates the strongest and most consistent performance among all the evaluated models, suggesting robust internalization of maqama-style constraints. By contrast, GPT-4o produces fluent and coherent Arabic but remains weaker in authenticity and saj’, indicating that surface fluency does not guarantee successful classical style imitation. Open-weight models perform substantially worse overall, showing that general Arabic capability alone remains insufficient for this genre.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.4-mini显示了所有被评价模型中最强和最一致的性能,表明对maqama型限制的强烈内化。 反之,GPT-4o生产流利而连贯的阿拉伯语,但真实性和Saj性仍然较弱,这表明表面流畅并不能保证古典风格模仿的成功。 开放重量型号的总体表现要差得多,表明仅阿拉伯语一般能力不足以应付这一流派。

blocks.en: We note that differences may partially reflect instruction-following fidelity and pretraining exposure to classical Arabic registers, rather than purely generative capacity in isolation.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,差异可能部分反映了遵循忠贞的教学和对接触古典阿拉伯语登记册的预先训练,而不是孤立地纯粹的遗传能力。

blocks.en: Prompting affects models unevenly. Most models benefit from structured prompting, especially few-shot examples, but these gains are concentrated in surface-level features. Saj’ emerges as the most prompt-sensitive dimension, indicating that rhythmic and rhymed prose can be partially induced through prompting. In contrast, creativity and rhetoric remain relatively stable, suggesting that deeper literary competence is largely model-bound.
blocks.zh: 提示对模型的影响不均匀。 大多数模型都得益于有条理的催化,特别是少有镜头的例子,但这些增益集中于地表层面的特征. Saj最迅速的敏感维度, 相比之下,创造力和修辞力仍然相对稳定,这表明更深层次的文学能力在很大程度上是模式性的.

blocks.en: Interestingly, ALLaM exhibits non-monotonic behavior, where prompting sometimes degrades performance rather than improving it. This may indicate interference between imposed stylistic constraints and the model’s existing Arabic generation priors.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,ALLAM展现出非莫名的行为,其中激发有时会降低性能而不是改善性能. 这可能表明在强加的语义限制与该模型现有的阿拉伯世代前辈之间发生了干扰。

blocks.en: Finally, the strong agreement between absolute and pairwise evaluation suggests that the observed ranking is robust across evaluation paradigms, reinforcing confidence in the overall findings.
blocks.zh: 最后,绝对评价与对等评价之间的强烈一致表明,所观察到的排名在所有评价范式中都很有力,增强了对整个评价结果的信心。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we evaluated the ability of modern language models to generate maqama-style Arabic text using a dual evaluation framework combining absolute rubric-based scoring and pairwise comparison.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们评价了现代语言模型利用双重评价框架生成maqama风格的阿拉伯语文本的能力,这种框架结合了绝对的以数字为基础的评分和对等比较。

blocks.en: Our results establish a clear performance hierarchy, with GPT-5.4-mini achieving the strongest results, followed by GPT-4o, while open-weight models remain significantly behind. We further show that prompting can improve weaker models, particularly in stylistic dimensions such as saj’, but has limited impact on stronger models.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果确立了明确的性能等级,GPT-5.4-mini取得了最强的成绩,其次是GPT-4o,而开放量级模型仍然显著落后. 我们进一步显示,促动可以改进较弱的模式,特别是在诸如Saj等结构层面,但对较强的模式影响有限。

blocks.en: These findings suggest that maqama generation depends not only on grammatical fluency, but also on deeper stylistic and rhetorical competence that remains difficult for most models to acquire.
blocks.zh: 这些研究结果表明,maqama的生成不仅取决于语法流利,而且取决于大多数模型仍然难以获得的更深层次的语气和修辞能力.

blocks.en: Future work can extend this setting toward longer-form maqamat with richer narrative structure and stronger alignment to classical exemplars such as al-Hamadhani and al-Hariri, enabling evaluation of both local stylistic fidelity and long-range literary coherence.
blocks.zh: 未来的工作可以将这一背景扩展至较长的maqamat,其叙事结构更为丰富,更紧密地与古典范例如al-Hamadhani和al-Hariri保持一致,从而能够评价当地的语气忠诚度和长期文学一致性。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: This study has several limitations that should be considered when interpreting the results.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有一些局限性,在解释结果时应予考虑。

blocks.en: We evaluate short-form maqama-style generations over 14 curated topics. This setup does not capture the full structural and thematic complexity of classical maqama literature, which involves longer narratives and richer discourse development.
blocks.zh: 我们评价短形马卡玛风格的几代人 超过14个课程 这种设置没有抓住古典maqama文学的全部结构和主题复杂性,这涉及到更长的叙述和更丰富的论述发展.

blocks.en: We rely mainly on LLM-as-a-judge with a structured rubric, supported by pairwise comparisons and limited human evaluation. While rankings are consistent across methods, automated judgments may still reflect model-specific bias, and human evaluation is not large enough to serve as a full reference standard.
blocks.zh: 我们主要依靠具有结构化标题的LLM-as-a法官,辅以对等比较和有限的人类评价。 虽然不同方法的排名一致,但自动判断仍然可能反映模式特有的偏差,人的评价不够大,不足以作为全面参考标准.

blocks.en: Pairwise results are computed over a stratified sample of 420 comparisons rather than exhaustively over all pairs, introducing potential sampling variance.
blocks.zh: 对等结果通过420个分层比较的样本计算,而不是对所有对子进行详尽的比较,从而产生潜在的抽样差异。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work involves the generation of culturally and historically grounded literary text. While we do not observe direct harmful outputs, we note that models may reproduce simplified or stereotypical representations of cultural identities. Care must be taken when interpreting generated narratives as they reflect statistical learning rather than historical understanding.
blocks.zh: 这部作品涉及创作基于文化和历史的文学文字. 虽然我们没有看到直接的有害产出,但我们注意到,模式可能重复对文化特征的简化或陈规定型表述。 在解释生成的叙述时必须小心,因为它们反映的是统计学习而不是历史理解。

blocks.en: AI Usage Statement
blocks.zh: AI 用法声明

All generated content was carefully reviewed and validated by the authors. The research hypotheses, experimental design, implementation, and final scientific conclusions were conceived and conducted entirely by the authors.

blocks.en: To illustrate the stylistic target of our generation setup, we provide an excerpt from al-Hamadhani’s al-Maqama al-Ḥamdaniyya (المقامة الحمدانية), one of the earliest and most influential examples of the genre. This excerpt demonstrates several defining maqama properties: framed narration, rhymed prose (saj’), dense rhetorical ornamentation, lexical symmetry, and performative eloquence.

blocks.en: Isa ibn Hisham narrated to us, saying: One day we attended the court of Sayf al-Dawla ibn Hamdan, when a horse was presented before him, so splendid that any eye rising to behold it found delight. The gathering gazed upon it, and Sayf al-Dawla said: “Whichever of you describes it best, I shall grant it to him.” Each man exerted himself and offered what he knew. Then one of his servants said: “May God preserve the prince! Yesterday I saw a man who tramples eloquence beneath his sandals, toward whom all eyes turn, who questions men and pours despair upon them.” So he was brought in at once, clothed in two worn garments upon which time had eaten and drunk. blocks.en: This excerpt illustrates the central mechanics of the maqama genre: the framed narrative voice, the staged performance of eloquence, and the dense use of saj’ and rhetorical embellishment. These features motivate the dimensions used in our evaluation framework, particularly authenticity, rhetoric, coherence, and saj’ density.
blocks.zh: 这段节录说明了maqama流派的核心力学:框框式的叙事声,戏剧化的表演,以及大量使用Saj和华丽的装饰。 这些特征激发了我们评价框架中所使用的层面,特别是真实性、言辞、一致性和Saj密度。

blocks.en: You are a literary critic deeply versed in the Arabic tradition, examining texts through the lens of the early masters of rhetoric and weighing them by the standards of eloquence and expression, as did al-Jurjani and Ibn al-Athir. Use the following rating scale from 1 to 5: 1 = Very far from the spirit of the maqama 2 = A weak attempt that fails as imitation 3 = A moderate text showing some maqama features 4 = A strong text approaching the classical style 5 = An exceptional text that could almost be mistaken for authentic classical prose Topic: {topic} Text: {text} Deliver your literary judgment, then record your scores according to the criteria above.

blocks.en: D.2 Prompt Sensitivity

blocks.en: We next analyze the sensitivity of models to prompting strategies (zero-shot, rule-based, and few-shot). Table 7 reports the best and worst-performing conditions per model.

blocks.en: As reported in Table 7 , prompt sensitivity varies significantly across models. GPT-4o and Qwen benefit substantially from structured prompting, indicating partial reliance on external scaffolding. In contrast, GPT-5.4-mini remains highly stable, suggesting strong internalization of maqama-style constraints. Interestingly, ALLaM shows only marginal gains from prompting and even slight degradation under few-shot settings, suggesting possible over-constraining effects. Detailed analyses of evaluated dimensions is provided in D.5 .
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,各模型的迅速敏感性差别很大。 GPT-4o和Quen从结构化的提示中大大受益,表明部分依赖外部脚手架。 相比之下,GPT-5.4-mini仍然保持高度稳定,表明马卡马式约束的强烈内化. 有趣的是,ALLAM只显示在几发情况下从催化甚至轻微降解得到的微小收益,这表明可能存在过度约束效应. D.5详细分析了评价的维度。

blocks.en: D.3 Agreement Between Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: D.3 评价议定书之间的协议

blocks.en: We measure agreement between absolute scoring and pairwise ranking using Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient. The results are shown in Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 我们用斯皮尔曼的排名关联系数来测量绝对得分和对等排名之间的一致。 调查结果见表8。

blocks.en: Table 8: Correlation between absolute and pairwise rankings.
blocks.zh: 表8:绝对排名与对等排名的相对关系.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 8 , the perfect monotonic correlation indicates that both evaluation paradigms yield fully consistent rankings, reinforcing the robustness of the evaluation framework.
blocks.zh: 如表8所示,完美的单一关系表明,两种评价范式的排名完全一致,加强了评价框架的稳健性。

blocks.en: D.4 Dimension Difficulty
blocks.zh: D.4 难度

blocks.en: We next analyze the intrinsic difficulty of each literary dimension by averaging scores across all models and conditions. The results are reported in Table 9 , which reveals a clear hierarchy of difficulty: grammatical correctness is relatively well handled across models, whereas higher-level literary attributes such as authenticity and creativity remain significantly underdeveloped. This suggests that maqama generation is constrained more by stylistic and narrative competence than by surface-level linguistic proficiency.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来分析每个文学维度的内在困难 通过平均得分 在所有模型和条件。 其结果在表9中报告,该表揭示了明显的难度等级:语法正确性在模型中处理得相对良好,而真实性和创造力等更高层次的文学属性则仍然相当不发达. 这表明maqama一代更多地受到语气和叙事能力的限制,而不是表层语言熟练程度的限制.

blocks.en: Table 9: Average score by dimension.
blocks.zh: 表9:按尺寸分列的平均得分。

blocks.en: D.5 Model-wise Prompt Dynamics
blocks.zh: D.5 模型快速动态

blocks.en: We now turn to a fine-grained analysis of how prompting strategies affect each model across individual literary dimensions. Table 10 presents results for zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based prompting across all models and dimensions.
blocks.zh: 我们现在转而对激励性战略如何影响各个文学层面的每个模式进行精细分析。 表10列出了所有模型和维度的零射、少射和基于规则的提示结果。

blocks.en: Table 10: Fine-grained evaluation across models, prompting strategies, and literary dimensions.
blocks.zh: 表10:各种模式的精细评价、激励战略和文学层面。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 10 , GPT-5.4-mini is largely invariant across prompting conditions, suggesting strong internalization of maqama-style constraints, yet, it still shows improvement in saj’ and creativity with few-shot and rule prompting. GPT-4o exhibits moderate sensitivity, particularly in stylistic dimensions such as saj’ and rhetoric, where few-shot prompting consistently improves performance. In contrast, ALLaM shows non-monotonic behavior, with occasional degradation under few-shot prompting, suggesting possible over-constraining effects. Open-weight models (LLaMA and Qwen) remain unstable and show limited consistent gains from prompting, indicating insufficient capacity for reliable stylistic control.
blocks.zh: 如表10所示,GPT-5.4-mini在催化条件下基本上变化不大,这表明马卡马式限制的强烈内化,然而,它仍然显示出Saj和创造力的改善,少有镜头和规则提示。 GPT-4o表现出温和的敏感性,特别是在风格层面,如Saj ' 和夸夸其谈,很少的镜头能不断提高性能。 相比之下,ALLAM表现出非运动行为,偶尔在几发催促下降解,暗示了可能的过度约束效应. 开放量级模型(LLaMA和Quen)仍然不稳定,并且显示从催化得到的一致收益有限,表明可靠的结构控制能力不足.

blocks.en: D.6 Dimension-level Prompt Sensitivity
blocks.zh: D.6 尺寸级的迅速敏感性

blocks.en: Finally, we aggregate across models to analyze which literary dimensions are most sensitive to prompting strategies. The results are shown in Table 11 .
blocks.zh: 最后,我们综合了各种模型,分析哪些文学层面对推动战略最敏感。 调查结果见表11。

blocks.en: Table 11: Sensitivity of literary dimensions to prompting strategies (higher Δ \Delta indicates stronger prompt dependence).
blocks.zh: 表11:文学维度对激发策略的敏感性(更高 QQ\Delta表示更强烈的即时依赖性).

blocks.en: As shown in Table 11 , Saj’ is the most prompt-sensitive dimension, indicating that rhymed prose structure can be effectively influenced through examples. Grammar and coherence show moderate sensitivity, suggesting partial controllability of surface linguistic structure. In contrast, rhetoric and creativity exhibit minimal variation, implying that deeper literary competence is largely model-dependent rather than prompt-driven.
blocks.zh: 如表11所示,Saj's是最迅速的敏感维度,表明押韵的传言结构可以通过实例有效影响. 语法和一致性表现出温和的敏感性,暗示了表层语言结构的部分可控制性. 相反,言辞和创造力的差别很小,这意味着更深的文学能力在很大程度上依赖于模型,而不是迅速驱动。
